A **mutex protects shared state by allowing one owner at a time**. A **semaphore manages a count of permits**, typically to limit concurrency or signal between threads.

| | Mutex | Semaphore |
|---|---|---|
| State | Locked or unlocked | A permit count |
| Acquire | Takes the lock; waits if already held | Consumes a permit; waits if none are available |
| Release | Must be done by the owner | Can be done by another thread; adds a permit |
| Typical use | Protecting a shared data structure | Limiting concurrent work or signaling readiness |

| Part | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `^` | Start of the string |
| `(?: … )+` | Repeat the enclosed non-capturing group one or more times |
| `[a-z0-9-]+` | One or more lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens |
| `\.` | A literal dot |
| `[a-z]{2,}` | A final segment containing at least two lowercase letters |
| `$` | End of the string¹ |
